note: Putter head box relative to the Gen3's bracelet_link, measured with the arm at the stroke's frame-72 (address) pose; the address is at the ball (face 0.5 cm behind it). rel_pos is Unreal cm in the bracelet's frame, rel_quat is Unreal (x, y, z, w), size is the full box size in cm (toe, thickness, height). The face is square to the lane (aim 0 degrees), which sends the struck ball straight on hole 1.
